titulo_es: Undefined and negative pronouns: кто-то, что-нибудь, никто, никакой, сам

себя.es: a sí mismo/a (forma oblicua; aquí acusativo)
себя.en: to himself / a (oblique form; here accusative)

кто-нибудь.en: someone not specified (common in questions / conditions)

себе.es: a sí mismo/a (dativo o preposicional; aquí tras о)
себе.en: to itself / a (dative or prepositional; here after us)

никого.en: to no one; from no one (genitive / accusative)

texto: **-То** usually presents someone or something as existing, even if not identified: **Кто-то звонил** (someone called). **-Нибудь** leaves identity open and is common in questions, requests and conditions: **Ты что-нибудь хочешь?** (do you want something?). The use depends on the context.
These forms decline and maintain the script: **кто-то → кого-то**, **что-нибудь → чего-нибудь**.

**Никто/ничто** usually accompany **не** in the verb: **Никто не пришёл** (no one came), **Я ничего не знаю** (I know nothing). **нет** uses the **никого**: **Никого нет** genitive. They also change by case: **Я никому не сказал** (I didn't tell anyone).
**Никакой** matches the noun and also declines: **никакой проблемы нет** (there is no problem).
**Себя** is the reflexive pronoun that refers to the subject and changes according to the case: **Я вижу себя** (I see) / **Я думаю о себе** (I think of myself). It has no form of nomination.
**Сам/сама/сами** emphasizes who does something and agrees with that person: **Я сам это сделал** (I did it myself, man); **Я сама это сделала** (I did it myself, woman).

filas: someone / something not specified (often in questions)
Я сама не знаю. / Я сам перезвоню.
reflexive; changes depending on the case

frases.ru: Кто-то звонил, пока тебя не было.
frases.en: Someone called while you were gone.

frases.ru: Кто? Мне никто ничего не сказал.
frases.en: Who? No one told me anything.
analisis: No one said anything (negative pronouns + не)

frases.ru: Я сама не знаю, кто это.
frases.es: Yo misma no sé quién era.
frases.en: I don't know who I was myself.
analisis: I myself (the speaker is a woman)

frases.es: Vale, yo mismo volveré a llamar.

bloques.pregunta: What do you mean, «No one came.»?

opciones.explicacion: -Нибудь leaves the person unspecified; it is common in questions and conditions, although it is not limited only to questions.
**Кто-нибудь** does not identify a particular person; **кто-то** usually presents someone as an existing person, even if the speaker does not say who he is.
Думать о себе: after **о**, **себе** (prepositional) is used, not the accusative **себя**.
**Себя** is accusative; after **о** the **себе** prepositional is used.
**Сам** emphasizes the subject; it does not replace the reflexive **себе**.
It doesn't say that in the phrase.

intro: Today you learn to say «Someone.», «Something.», «No one.», «None» and «self». In Russian there are several forms, and each has a different use.
